name: Flour Girls
source:
You play as Penny, a 24-year-old pizza delivery girl who can't help but fall in love with one of two girls... or both?

[From [url=https://flarechess.itch.io/flour-girls]Itch.io[/url]]

你將扮演24歲的披薩外送員彭妮。她不由自主地愛上了兩個女孩中的一個……還是說，兩個都愛上了？
